text:
Find out why waste_windows in crates/athena-core/src/status/throughput.rs counts no unlanded attempts in the newest window. Fix it so jobs that ran a model and closed without landing in the window are counted. Example: job 20261110-163344-3gaa was rejected at 16:55 UTC on 10 Nov after spending money, yet review 20261110-191047-6szm at 19:10 UTC records wasted_usd 0.0 and attempts_per_landing 1.0. The suspected cause, not yet shown, is that window cut times come from landing ends that later landing records move forward (the code comment on waste_windows notes this). Show the cause from the records before changing the code. Acceptance: (1) a test built from a real record shape (landings, then a rejected job with invocations, then more landings) counts the rejected job and its cost in the newest window; (2) recomputing the waste figures on the current records gives a nonzero wasted_usd for the window holding 10 Nov's rejections; (3) fmt, clippy and tests pass; (4) a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Throughput reviews record wasted_usd 0.0 and attempts_per_landing 1.0 in four reviews in a row, although costed jobs were rejected in those windows
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
